jumbo_emoji_size_description: Adjust the size of emojis sent without text.
blur_media_description: Blurs images and videos in the timeline.
blur_avatars_description: Blurs user profile pictures and room icons.
colorful_names_description: Assign unique colors to users based on their ID. Does not override room/space custom colors. Will override default role colors.
show_pronoun_pills_description: Display user pronouns in the message timeline.
pronoun_pill_max_count_description: Maximum number of pronoun pills shown per user in the timeline. Additional pronouns appear behind the ... pill.
pronoun_pill_max_length_description: Maximum characters shown in each pronoun pill before truncation.
pronoun_pills_for_all_description: Attempts to convert pronouns in names into pills (e.g. [they/them] or (it/its) turns into a pill).
custom_profile_cards_description: Choose whose profile card colors to show: everyone with a scheme, only light or dark schemes, or hide them.
render_global_username_colors_descriptio: Display the username colors anyone can set in their account settings.
render_space_room_username_colors_descri: Display the username colors that can be set with /color.
render_space_room_fonts_description: Display the username fonts that can be set with /font.
consistent_icon_style_description: Harmonize icon appearance with background fill
show_pronouns_only_in_selected_language_: Show pronouns only in selected language

If enabled, pronouns are only shown when they match your selected language. This helps if your contacts set pronouns in different languages. It doesn't affect how your pronouns are shared with others.
selected_language_for_pronouns_descripti: The language to show pronouns for when the above setting is enabled.
